null_rules.statement: The member may be null only in a document whose status is refused.
The member is null exactly when /request/missing_mass/applied is false.
The member is null exactly when /request/modal_combination is not CQC.
The member is null exactly when /request/modal_combination is not GROUPING.
The member is null exactly when /request/modal_combination is not TEN_PERCENT.
The member is null exactly when /request/modal_combination is neither GROUPING nor TEN_PERCENT.
The member is null exactly when /request/directional_combination is not 100-40-40.
The member is null exactly when /modal_result/binding is not_applicable.
The member is null exactly when /modal_result/binding is bound.
The member is null exactly when /origin/kind is spectrum_solve.
The member is null exactly when /modal_basis/extraction/endpoint is whole_finite_spectrum.
The member is null exactly when /modal_basis/clusters has no rows.
In a value object: value is null exactly when undefined_reason is not null; undefined_reason is null exactly when value is not null.

tokens: Experimental response-spectrum preview under uniform support motion, formed from the signed modal and rigid contributions of a small-displacement, linear-elastic modal basis, with damping represented only through the user's pseudo-acceleration spectra; it is not a public engineering result, it is not recorded as an analysis run, and it establishes neither physical correctness nor code compliance.

Every row is the response to the support motion alone, about the state the modal model was formed at: a combined row is an unsigned magnitude in its stated frame, formed in that frame from signed contributions, and is never a signed quantity, a total force with the state's own action, or a stress; a signed contribution or a signed cluster sum is not a peak response.

That this document is consistent with itself and with the inputs it states does not show that the census is the model's, that a stated frame is the entity's, that the modal basis is an eigenbasis of the model, that a signed contribution was recovered correctly, or that the product produced the document.
Produced by the product's experimental spectrum solve.

Constructed from the signed contributions of a frozen reference, not produced by a spectrum solve; its combined magnitudes are formed from those contributions by the product's combinations. It is not evidence that the product recovers these contributions.

E is the exact sum of the stated binary64 effective masses of the periodic modes. S is E rounded once to the nearest binary64 (ties to even). U is the exact difference T − E, rounded once the same way. U is not T minus the published S, and the two can differ: where E rounds to T, T minus the published S is zero while the mass the periodic modes leave out is not. The cumulative fraction is the binary64 quotient of the published S by T and the unrepresented fraction the binary64 quotient of the published U by T, each rounded to nearest; they state what fraction of the published total each published mass is, and are recomputable from the published values. T is the stated total mass of the direction, which includes the mass that moves with the supports. Where T is zero both fractions are undefined.

Every spectrum ordinate is a pseudo-spectral acceleration: omega squared times the peak relative displacement of a linear oscillator at the spectrum's damping. No other kind of spectrum is converted and no spectrum is extrapolated.
Uniform support motion: in each requested direction every rigid support moves with the ground. Independent support motion is not built.

Damping is represented only through the spectra. Each mode's quantities are recovered at its displacement extremum, and the velocity-proportional parts of forces and reactions are neglected; this is an adopted approximation, and no bound on the resulting force or reaction error is claimed.

The modes of each cluster of the modal basis are summed with their signs first and the modal rule is applied across the clusters. A cluster is the modal basis's numerical convention, not a statement that its eigenvalues are equal; for a cluster whose modes have unequal frequencies, summing first is an adopted convention, and no independence from the modal basis is claimed for it.

The missing-mass correction is applied. The rigid response is the static response, on the dynamic stiffness, to the inertia at the rigid acceleration of everything the periodic modes leave out; it assumes that the modes classified as rigid respond in phase with the ground.
The missing-mass correction is not applied: every extracted mode is periodic, and the mass the periodic modes do not represent is disclosed with its fractions and is not in any row.

Realized bends enter the modal basis with the thin curved-beam stiffness, whose application range SWBPIPE's verification has not established (LIM-021, an applicability limitation); this result inherits it through the modal basis.

Periodic clusters in ascending order form groups. A group starts at a cluster, whose standing frequency f_g is the group's lowest, and takes each next cluster whose standing frequency f satisfies (f − f_g) / f_g ≤ 1/10; the next cluster that does not starts a new group. The comparison is decided exactly on the represented frequencies.

Two periodic clusters i < j are coupled when their standing frequencies satisfy (f_j − f_i) / f_i ≤ 1/10, whether or not they fall in one group of the grouping method. The comparison is decided exactly on the represented frequencies.

document_shape.statement: Every object of a spectrum result document has exactly the members its shape declares: the shape's members and, where the shape has variants, those of the alternative its `by` member's token selects. Each member is of its type, or null where its null rule permits. The document itself is of shape document.

types.statement: A JSON string that is one of the stated tokens.
A JSON number written as an integer, from 0 to 2^53 - 1.
A JSON number within the checked canonical profile (finite, of magnitude below 2^53).
An object of shape value_object whose kind is one of the stated kinds and whose unit is that kind's catalog unit in value_kinds.
A string that is the row_id of a row of the sealed table at the JSON pointer its target states, in the same document.
A JSON array whose every item is of the stated type, of the stated length where one is stated.
An object of the named shape.

A sealed table: an object with exactly the members status (the token published), row_count (an integer, the number of rows), digest (the SHA-256, lowercase hex, of the canonical text of the array of the rows' checksum strings in row order) and rows (an array of objects of the named row shape). Each row has, beside its shape's members, row_id (a string, unique in the table), ordinal (an integer, its zero-based position in rows) and checksum (the SHA-256, lowercase hex, of the canonical text of the row without its checksum member).
An object whose members are exactly the directions of /rows/directions, each of the stated type.
Any JSON value within the checked canonical profile; its content is attributed, not checked here.
A member whose null rule permits it may be null in place of its type.

frames.axes: the global X, Y and Z axes
a straight member's axes: x from end i to end j, y the part of the member's reference vector normal to x, normalized, z = x cross y; stated per member in the census as vectors in global axes
an arc's tangent frame at the row's end, the static result's (DEL-04-01/REQ-018); stated per arc end in the census as vectors in global axes
a connector's own axes; stated per connector in the census as vectors in global axes
a tie rod's axis from its attachment at end i to its attachment at end j; stated per rod in the census as one oriented unit vector in global axes

held.statement: Where one support holds the constraint, the row is that support's reaction.
The row states that it is the reaction of the constraint, that the supports it names hold it together, and that it is not divided between them or to be added once per support.

frames.static_row: the static nodal displacement or rotation of that node and component, in global axes
the static global end-action row of that member at that end and component

the static element-local end row of that member at that end and component, in the member's local frame; on an EX pressure member the axial row takes the frame and sign of the static wall axial end action
the static global end-action row of that arc at that end and component
the static element-local end row of that arc at that end and component, in the arc tangent frame at that end
the static connector-local force of that connector and component, without its reference displacement
the static connector end action of that connector, end and component
the static tie-rod force of that connector's rod, without its reference elongation or pretension

where one support holds the constraint, that support's static reaction of the same component where the static result publishes one; a constraint held by more than one support, or by a snubber alone, has no static row
that support's static action of the same component; a snubber has no static row

sign_conventions.statement: A displacement is positive along its global axis; a rotation is positive by the right-hand rule about its global axis.

The generalized force acting on the element at its end node, each component positive along the axis of the row's frame; a moment is about the end node, positive by the right-hand rule. For a member or an arc the internal section force at end i is its negative.
A connector's generalized force, positive along its connector axes and work-conjugate to its relative displacements; a moment is positive by the right-hand rule.
A tie rod's axial force, positive in tension, its axis running from its attachment at end i to its attachment at end j.
The force or moment the support applies to the piping, positive along the global axis; a moment is about the node, positive by the right-hand rule.

sign_statuses.statement: signed contribution, not a peak response
signed sum of one cluster's contributions, not a peak response
unsigned combined magnitude; it has no sign
